comment: Device Hub Pro Controls inspector — value-popup and slider geometry inside the Display & sound group (CT-06/CT-07). The group is collapsed by default, so this reference is evaluated against the saved capture a saved 2x capture, where the app ran with DHP_CONTROLS_EXPAND_ALL=1, the Controls inspector was open on the Pixel 9 Pro Fold emulator, the first seven groups (Network, Power & battery, Location, Sensors, Telephony, Advanced, Foldable) were collapsed and Display & sound was expanded at the top of the panel. Run: PARITY_IMAGE=a saved 2x capture PARITY_SCALE=2 PARITY_REFERENCE=Scripts/parity-reference-controls-display.json bash Scripts/parity-check.sh. Coordinates are window points from the capture's top-left; the audited values live in ParityMetrics.swift (CT-06/CT-07).
